diario: Download the PDF and print one sheet for each workday.
Fill in the date, client and progress, and check the day's weather.
List the crew on site with each person's role, hours and attendance, plus any extra labour.
Write down the work done and the incidents, and number the day's photos.
At the end of the day, the person responsible signs.
